events.title: Wild Crazy 8s is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Next Fest is on, and Wild Crazy 8s is in it. The demo is the full Tame-difficulty run: all nine floors, free, no time limit, your own save.Three weeks to launch. November 11. The wishlist button does more this week than any other week. If the demo earns it, press it.

events.title: You Asked, We Dealt: A Sharper Tutorial + an In-Game Rulebook
events.summary: Early playtesters gave us a clear note: the practice table teaches the basics well, but some of you walked away with questions — how exactly the scoring works, what the rest of the action cards do, and where to look something up in the middle of a run. That's exactly the feedback we want. Here's what we did about it. events.title: Every 8 is wild - Wild Crazy 8s launches November 11
events.summary: Wild Crazy 8s is a roguelike deckbuilder built on Crazy Eights, the card game where eights go wild. An 8 plays on anything, calls the next suit, and keeps a scoring chain alive. The run: climb nine floors of a neon casino, beat the boss table at the top of each one, and spend your winnings in the Gift Shop on House Rules that warp the math of every card you play. I'm kfancy. I built this game solo, and it launches on Steam on November 11, 2026. A free demo is coming soon, and it won't be a slice
